chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'PS3 fat console CECHA untested' and 'Nintendo Wii U console GamePad untested' (last 90 days, sold); also 'Sony Playstation 3 CECHA 60GB backwards compatible' sold.
viewing_check: Read the model label on each PS3 underside: CECHAxx/CECHBxx (60GB, hardware PS2 compatible) or CECHCxx/CECHExx (80GB) are worth far more than CECHG/H and later. Check for yellow-light or missing HDDs, whether the Wii U is the 8GB white or 32GB black, GamePad screen scratches, and that the DS/3DS and sensor bar are genuine.
